summary: Describes how URI signing can enforce content access control between interconnected content delivery networks (CDNI). It proposes a method built as a profile of JSON Web Tokens (JWT), specifying where the signed token travels in the URI and which claims it must hold so a user agent can be authorized to fetch content. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A concert ticket has a stamp only the venue can make. A signed web link works the same way: it carries a stamp that proves you are allowed in, so the helper servers can check it.
